oneOf.description: Worth keeping, not needed day to day: goes to cold storage.
Nothing settled it yet: an arbiter or the user must decide.

Matcher.description: Conditions on a folder. All the conditions given must hold.

contains.description:
The folder directly contains an entry with one of these names
(case-insensitive). Use it to tell a real `venv` from a folder that
merely shares the name.

name_in.description: The folder name is one of these (case-insensitive).

path_glob.description:
The path relative to the scan root matches this glob. `/` separates
components, `*` stays within one component, `**` crosses them.
Case-insensitive.

Rule.description: Settles a folder and everything under it.

decision.description: `review` is not allowed here: it is the absence of a decision.

id.description: Unique within the pack, lowercase, dash-separated.
